questions.content:
解析:(1)先求半球壳的质心位置为:

$$x_{c} = \frac{1}{m} \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} R \sin \theta \mathrm{d}m = \frac{1}{m} \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} R \sin \theta \frac{m}{2 \pi R^{2}} 2 \pi R \cos \theta R \mathrm{d}\theta = \frac{1}{2} R\tag{1}$$

而圆锥面质心的位置距离圆锥顶点为:

$$x_{c}^{'} = \frac{1}{m} \int_{0}^{R \cot \theta} x \frac{m}{\pi R \frac{R}{\sin \theta}} 2 \pi x \tan \theta \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\cos \theta} = \frac{2}{3} R \cot \theta\tag{2}$$

系统质心在圆心，则

$$mx_{c}=m(R\cot\theta-{x_{c}}')\tag{3}$$

圆锥的半顶角θ为:

$$\cot \theta = \frac{3}{2}   或   \theta = \arccos\frac{3}{2}\tag{4}$$

考虑圆锥面绕半径转动惯量为:

$$I_{辘} = \int_{0}^{R \cot \theta} m \frac{2 \pi x \cdot \tan \theta}{\pi R \frac{R}{\sin \theta}} \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\cos \theta} \left[ (R \cot \theta - x)^2 + \frac{(x \cdot \tan \theta)^2}{2} \right] = \frac{5}{8} m R^2\tag{5}$$

则不倒翁绕过球心某一直径的转动惯为:

$$I = I_{ 锥 } + \frac{2}{3}mR^{2} = \frac{31}{24}mR^{2}\tag{6}$$

(2)在B点着地前，质心的高度始终不变，则质心运动定理:

$$-\mu2mg = 2ma_{c}\tag{7}$$

$$a _ { c } = - \mu g\tag{8}$$

相对过质心的水平轴，角动量定理:

$$2 \mu m g R = I \beta\tag{9}$$

$$\beta = \frac{2\mu mgR}{I} = \frac{48\mu g}{31R}\tag{10}$$

则纯滚动要求:

$$\frac{J}{2m} - a_{c}t = v_{1} = \omega_{1}R = \beta tR\tag{11}$$

$$v_{1}=\frac{48}{79}\sqrt{gR}\ \omega_{1}=\frac{48}{79}\sqrt{\frac{g}{R}}\tag{12}$$

则要求B点着地之前已经到达纯滚动，摩擦系数有:

$$\mu=\frac{\omega_{1}^{2}}{2\cdot\frac{\pi}{2}(\frac{48}{31}\frac{g}{R})}=\frac{1488}{6241\pi}\approx0.0759\tag{13}$$

在B点着地前，如图所示:

![](data/images/2023-ee12bca3/2023-量子-答案_part01-1.jpg)

$$2mgR(1-\cos\alpha)=\frac{1}{2}(I+2mR^{2})(\omega^{2}-\omega_{1}^{2})\tag{14}$$

则有:

$$\omega^{2}=\frac{96}{79}(1-\cos\alpha)\frac{g}{R}+\frac{576}{6241}\frac{J^{2}}{m^{2}R^{2}}=\left(\frac{103}{79}-\cos\alpha\right)\frac{96}{79}\frac{g}{R}\tag{15}$$

对时间求导则有:

$$2\omega\beta = \frac{96}{79}\sin\alpha\frac{g}{R}\cdot\omega\tag{16}$$

$$\beta = \frac{48}{79} \sin \alpha \frac{g}{R}\tag{17}$$

同时，B点临界发生位移时:

$$f = 2m(\beta R\cos\alpha - \omega^{2}R\sin\alpha)\tag{18}$$

$$2mg - N = 2m(\beta R\sin\alpha + \omega^{2}R\cos\alpha)\tag{19}$$

$$\mu = \frac{f}{N} = \frac{\beta R \cos \alpha - \omega^2 R \sin \alpha}{g - (\beta R \sin \alpha + \omega^2 R \cos \alpha)}\tag{20}$$

解得:

$$\alpha = 1 3 . 4 ^ { \circ }\tag{21}$$

![](data/images/2023-ee12bca3/2023-量子-答案_part01-2.jpg)

(3)如图，在D点加入质量为M的物体后，系统的质心在E点，

$$OE = \frac{2}{3}R\tag{22}$$

则，M质量为

$$M { = } 4 m\tag{23}$$

则，以质心处为势能零点，系统势能:

$$E _ { p } = M g R ( 1 - \cos \phi ) \approx 2 m g R \phi ^ { 2 }\tag{24}$$

系统动能:

$$E _ { k } = \frac { 1 } { 2 } I \dot { \phi } ^ { 2 } + \frac { 1 } { 2 } 2 m ( \dot { \phi } R ) ^ { 2 } = \frac { 7 9 } { 4 8 } m R ^ { 2 } \dot { \phi } ^ { 2 }\tag{25}$$

$$T = 2\pi \sqrt{\frac{\frac{79}{48}mR^{2}}{2mgR}} = 2\pi \sqrt{\frac{79}{96}\frac{R}{g}} = \frac{\pi}{2} \sqrt{\frac{79}{6}\frac{R}{g}} = 1.814\pi \sqrt{\frac{R}{g}} = 5.70\sqrt{\frac{R}{g}}\tag{26}$$

第(2)问:20分；(7)-(11)1分；(12)(13)(14)(15)(17)2分，(18)(19)(20)1分，(21)2分；

第(3)问:10分；(22)-(26)2分

tags: 力学/非惯性系/惯性力与约束运动/旋转参考系中的运动方程

questions.content:
解析:(1)小球刚下落到AB位置时，在旋转系中观测，小球进入铁丝后:

$$
v _ { 0 } = \sqrt { 2 g h }\tag{1}
$$

在角速度 $\omega _ { 0 }$ 的旋转参考系中，以圆心所在高度为势能零点，则:

$$
\frac{1}{2}m\nu_{0}^{2}-\frac{1}{2}m\omega_{0}^{2}R^{2}=\frac{1}{2}m\nu^{2}-\frac{1}{2}m\omega^{2}R^{2}\sin^{2}\theta-mgR\cos\theta\tag{2}
$$

可得:

$$
v^{2}=2gR\left(\frac{h}{R}+\cos\theta-2\cos^{2}\theta\right)\tag{3}
$$

由于cosθ∈[0,1]，且cosθ=1，ν²有最小值，故:

当h≥R，小球能到达最低点C，此时:

$$
v _ { c } = \sqrt { 2 g ( h - R ) }\tag{4}
$$

此时相互作用力满足:

$$
N_{1}-mg=\frac{mv_{c}^{2}}{R}\tag{5}
$$

$$
N_{2} = 2m\omega_{0}v_{c}\tag{6}
$$

则小球到C点时与铁丝的相互作用力大小为:

$$
N = \sqrt{N_{1}^{2} + N_{2}^{2}} = mg\sqrt{\frac{32(h - R)}{R} + \left(\frac{2h - R}{R}\right)^{2}}\tag{7}
$$

当h<R，小球不能到达的最低点，小球最低点满足:

$$
\cos \theta = \frac{1 + \sqrt{1 + 8\frac{h}{R}}}{4}\tag{8}
$$

$$
N = mg \cos \theta + m \omega_0^2 R \sin \theta \sin \theta = \frac{15R - 8h - \sqrt{R^2 + 8hR}}{4R} mg\tag{9}
$$

(2)在地面系中，只有小球的能量会发生变化，以圆心所在高度为势能零点:

$$
E = - 2mgR\cos\theta + \frac{1}{2}2m(v^{2} + (\omega_{0}R\sin\theta)^{2})\tag{10}
$$

可得:

$$
E = 2mgh - \frac{1}{2}2m\omega_{0}^{2}R^{2}\cos 2\theta\tag{11}
$$

外力功率有:

$$
P = \frac{\mathrm{d}E}{\mathrm{d}t} = 4m\omega_{0}^{2}R^{2}\sin\theta\cos\theta \cdot \dot{\theta}\tag{12}
$$

而由(3)可知:

$$
\dot{\theta}=\frac{v}{R}=\frac{\sqrt{2gh+2gR\cos\theta-\omega_{0}^{2}R^{2}\cos^{2}\theta}}{R}\tag{13}
$$

$$
P = 8 m g \sqrt { 2 g R } \sin 2 \theta \sqrt { 2 + \cos \theta - 2 \cos ^ { 2 } \theta }\tag{14}
$$

求导可得:

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}P}{\mathrm{d}t}\frac{1}{8mg\sqrt{2gR}}=2\cos2\theta\sqrt{2+\cos\theta-2\cos^{2}\theta}+\sin2\theta\frac{-\sin\theta+2\sin2\theta}{2\sqrt{2+\cos\theta-2\cos^{2}\theta}}\tag{15}
$$

$$
\theta = 0.868\mathrm{rad}\tag{16}
$$

外力功率最大值为:

$$
P _ { m } \approx 1 5 . 0 2 m g \sqrt { g R }\tag{17}
$$

(3)小球进入铁丝 AB后:

$$
( 2 m \cdot ( R \sin \theta ) ^ { 2 } + m R ^ { 2 } ) \omega = m R ^ { 2 } \omega _ { 0 }\tag{18}
$$

在刚进入的瞬间θ $= \frac { \pi } { 2 }$

$$
\omega _ { 1 } = \frac { 1 } { 3 } \omega _ { 0 }\tag{19}
$$

在此后系统能量守恒，小球到最低点的过程中满足:

$$
2(\frac{1}{2}m(\omega_{1}R)^{2}+\frac{1}{2}mv_{0}^{2})+\frac{1}{2}mR^{2}\omega_{1}^{2}=-2mgR\cos\theta+2(\frac{1}{2}mv^{2})+\frac{1}{2}mR^{2}\omega^{2}\tag{20}
$$

可得:

$$
v ^ { 2 } = 2 g h + 2 g R \cos \theta - \frac { \cos ^ { 2 } \theta } { 3 ( 3 - 2 \cos ^ { 2 } \theta ) } \omega _ { m } ^ { 2 } R ^ { 2 } + \frac { \omega _ { m } ^ { 2 } R ^ { 2 } \sin ^ { 2 } \theta } { ( 3 - 2 \cos ^ { 2 } \theta ) ^ { 2 } } \quad .\tag{21}
$$

若小球从任意高度落下时两小球都能到达最低点C，则应该去 $\mathbf { h } { = } 0   ,$ 且ν=0时，

$$
\omega _ { m } = \sqrt { \frac { 6 g } { R } }\tag{22}
$$

代入h=2R， $\omega _ { 0 } = \omega _ { \mathfrak { m } }$

$$
\frac{\left( \nu ^ { 2 } \right)}{\mathrm{d} \theta} \frac{1}{2 g R \sin \theta} = - 1 + \frac{2 \cos \theta}{\left( 3 - 2 \cos ^ { 2 } \theta \right)} + \frac{4 \cos ^ { 3 } \theta + 6 \cos \theta}{\left( 3 - 2 \cos ^ { 2 } \theta \right)^{2}} - \frac{24 \sin ^ { 2 } \theta \cos \theta}{\left( 3 - 2 \cos ^ { 2 } \theta \right)^{3}} = 0\tag{23}
$$

$$
\theta = 0.800   rad\tag{24}
$$

$$
v _ { m } = 2 . 3 8 0 \sqrt { g R }\tag{25}
$$

第(1)问:17分；(1)1分；(2)~(9)2分；

第(2)问:11分；(10)(11)1分，(12)(13)2分，(14)(15)(16)1分,(17)2分；

第(3)问:12分；(18)(20)2分，(19)(21)1分；(22)2分，(23)(24)1分，(25)2分。

questions.title: 第 03 题
tags: 力学/万有引力/引力势能/潮汐力
力学/万有引力/天体运动/潮汐演化与能量耗散

questions.content:
解析:(1)地表P(x,y,z)上质量为dm在地球平动参考系下引力和惯性力所受合力为潮汐力:

$$\vec { F } _ { \mathrm { 潮 } } = - \frac { G m \vec { r } _ { p } } { r _ { p } ^ { 3 } } \cdot \mathrm { d } m + \frac { G m \vec { r } _ { m } } { r _ { m } ^ { 3 } } \cdot \mathrm { d } m\tag{1}$$

由于 $\vec { r } _ { m } = r _ { m } \hat { k } , \quad \vec { r } _ { p } = \vec { r } _ { m } - \vec { r } = - x \hat { i } - y \hat { j } + ( r _ { m } - z ) \hat { k }$ ，则

$$\vec{F}_{潮} = G m \cdot \mathrm{d}m \left( \frac{1}{r_m^2} \hat{k} + \frac{-x \hat{i} - y \hat{j} + (r_m - z) \hat{k}}{\left(x^2 + y^2 + z^2 - 2 z r_m + r_m^2\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}} \right)\tag{2}$$

由于 ${r_{m}}^{2} \gg {R}^{2} = {x}^{2} + {y}^{2} + {z}^{2}$ ，则

$$\vec{F}_{潮} \approx G m \mathrm{d}m \frac{-x\hat{i}-y\hat{j}+2z\hat{k}}{r_m^3}\tag{3}$$

由于 $\int \vec{F}_{潮} \cdot \mathrm{d}\vec{r} = -\Delta U_{潮}$ ，故

$$\Delta U_{潮} = - \int G m \mathrm{d}m \cdot \frac{- x \hat{i} - y \hat{j} + 2 z \hat{k}}{r_m^3} \cdot \mathrm{d} \left( x \hat{i} + y \hat{j} + z \hat{k} \right)$$

$$\Delta U_{潮} = \frac{Gm\mathrm{d}m}{2r_{m}^{3}}\left(x^{2} + y^{2} - 2z^{2}\right)\tag{4}$$

接下来考虑地球的万有引力，考虑到地球半径远大于潮汐的起伏，则势函数为:

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}m} \approx \frac{Gm}{2{r_m}^3}\left(x^2 + y^2 - 2z^2\right) - \frac{GM}{R}\tag{5}$$

同样考虑到 $r \approx R \gg \Delta r,\cos \theta = \frac{z}{r},r^{2} = x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2}$

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}m}=-\frac{Gm}{r_{\mathrm{m}}^{3}}r^{2}\frac{3\cos^{2}\theta-1}{2}-\frac{GM}{r}\tag{6}$$

稳态时，故地球海洋表面是等势能面，令其为:

$$-\frac{Gm}{r_{\mathrm{m}}^{3}}r^{2}\frac{3\cos^{2}\theta-1}{2}-\frac{GM}{r}=-\frac{GM}{R}\tag{7}$$

设海潮表面相对于半径为R的球面起伏变化量为 $\Delta r$ ，即 $r= R+\Delta r$.考虑到 $\Delta r / R \ll 1 , R / r _ { \mathrm { m } } \ll 1$ ,将 $r = R + \Delta r$ 代入式(7)后展开，并分别保留小量 $\Delta r/R$ 和 $R / r _ { \mathrm { m } }$ 的最低次项:

$$\Delta r = \frac{m}{M} \frac{R^{4}}{r_{\mathrm{m}}^{3}} \frac{3 \cos^{2} \theta - 1}{2}\tag{8}$$

化简可得，考虑黄金代换公式:

$$\Delta r = \frac{m}{g} \frac{GR^{2}}{r_{\mathrm{m}}^{3}} \frac{3 \cos^{2} \theta - 1}{2}\tag{9}$$

代入 $\theta = 0 , \theta = \pi$ 5

$$\Delta h = \frac{3}{2} \frac{m}{g} \frac{GR^2}{r_{\mathrm{m}}^3}\tag{10}$$

代入数据可得:

$$\Delta h = \frac{3}{2} \frac{m}{g} \frac{GR^2}{r_{ m }^3} \approx 0.538  m\tag{11}$$

(2)由于地球变为弹性球模型，地球变为椭球，重新计算椭球的潮汐能，由(4):

$$U_{潮}=\iiint_{V}\frac{Gm\mathrm{d}m}{2r_{m}^{3}}\left(x^{2}+y^{2}-2z^{2}\right)=\iiint_{V}\frac{Gm\rho\mathrm{d}V}{2r_{m}^{3}}\left(x^{2}+y^{2}-2z^{2}\right)\tag{12}$$

由于地球不可压缩:

$$e = \frac{c}{a} = \frac{\sqrt{a^{2} - b^{2}}}{a} , \quad V = \frac{4\pi R^{3}}{3} = \iiint_{V} \mathrm{d}V = \frac{4\pi ab^{2}}{3}\tag{13}$$

利用题中所给的提示条件，有

$$U_{潮}=\frac{GMm}{5r_{m}^{3}}\left(b^{2}-a^{2}\right)\tag{14}$$

代入(14)则有:

$$U_{潮} = - \frac{GMmR^{2}}{5r_{m}^{3}} \frac{e^{2}}{\left( 1 - e^{2} \right)^{\frac{2}{3}}}\tag{15}$$

则弹性球总的势函数为:

$$V = - \frac{GMm}{5r_{\mathrm{m}}^{3}} \frac{R^{2}}{\left( 1 - e^{2} \right)^{2/3}} e^{2} - \frac{3}{10} \frac{GM^{2}}{R} \frac{\left( 1 - e^{2} \right)^{1/3}}{e} \ln \frac{1 + e}{1 - e} + \frac{38}{225} \pi \mu e^{4} R^{3}$$

由于 $e   \ll   1$ ,将上式右边前两项对e展开为幂级数，泰勒展开保留e的最低次项:

$$V = - \frac{3GM^{2}}{5R} - \frac{GMm}{5r_{m}^{3}}R^{2}e^{2} + \frac{GM^{2}}{75R}e^{4} + \frac{38}{225}\pi\mu e^{4}R^{3}\tag{16}$$

势能V取极小值时 $\frac { \mathrm { d } V } { \mathrm { d } e } = 0$

$$e^{2}=\frac{2GMmR^{2}}{5r_{m}^{3}}/\left(4\cdot\frac{GM^{2}}{75R}+4\cdot\frac{38}{225}\pi\mu R^{3}\right)\tag{17}$$

根据提示有:

$$r = R + \frac{15\rho R^{3}}{57\mu + 8\pi G\rho^{2}R^{2}}\frac{Gm\ 3\cos^{2}\theta - 1}{r_{\mathrm{m}}^{3}}\tag{18}$$

故地球固体潮涨落幅度为:

$$A = \frac{15\rho R^{3}}{57\mu + 8\pi G\rho^{2}R^{2}}\frac{3Gm}{2r_{ m }^{3}}\tag{19}$$

评分标准:

第(1)问:24分；(1)(2)(3)2分；(4)4分；(5)-(11)2分；

第(2)问:16分；(12)-(19)2分。

questions.title: 第 04 题
tags: 电磁学/电磁辐射/电偶极辐射/拉莫尔公式
电磁学/电磁辐射/电偶极辐射/辐射功率
力学/万有引力/天体运动/中子星形成
questions.content:
解析:(1)利用量纲分析可得:

$$
P = k e ^ { 2 } \dot { v } ^ { 2 } c ^ { - 3 }\tag{1}
$$

(2)坡印廷矢量为:

$$
\begin{aligned} &\vec{S} = \frac{c}{4\pi}\vec{E} \times \vec{H} = \frac{1}{4\pi c^{3}R^{5}}\left( \vec{R} \times \ddot{\vec{p}} \right) \times \left[ \vec{R} \times \left( \vec{R} \times \ddot{\vec{p}} \right) \right]\\ &= \frac{1}{4\pi c^{3}R^{5}}\left\{ \vec{R}(\vec{R} \times \ddot{\vec{p}})^{2} - \left( \vec{R} \times \ddot{\vec{p}} \right) \times \left[ \left( \vec{R} \times \ddot{\vec{p}} \right) \cdot \vec{R} \right] \right\}\\ &= \frac{1}{4\pi c^{3}R^{5}}\vec{R}(\vec{R} \times \ddot{\vec{p}})^{2}\\ \end{aligned}\tag{2}
$$

假设位置矢量 R 与 z轴的夹角为θ,则:

$$
\left| \vec{S} \right| = \frac{1}{4 \pi c^{3} R^{2}} \left( \vec{p} \right)^{2} \sin^{2} \theta\tag{3}
$$

考虑简谐振动:

$$
\begin{array} { r } { \dot { \vec { p } } = - \omega ^ { 2 } \vec { p } , } \end{array}\tag{4}
$$

则有:

$$
\left| S \right| = \frac{\omega^{4}}{4 \pi c^{3} R^{2}} p^{2} \sin^{2} \theta\tag{5}
$$

把上式对时间求平均后，得:

$$
\overline{S} = \frac{\omega^{4}}{4 \pi c^{3} R^{2}} \overline{p^{2}} \sin^{2} \theta\tag{6}
$$

$\overline { { p ^ { 2 } } }$ 是电偶极矩对时间的方均值，则考虑半径为R的球面，单位时间内通过该球面辐射出去的电磁波能量为:

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}W}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{\omega^{4} \overline{p^{2}}}{4 \pi c^{3} R^{2}} \int_{0}^{2 \pi} \int_{0}^{\pi} \sin^{2} \theta R^{2} \sin \theta \mathrm{d}\theta \mathrm{d}\varphi = \frac{\omega^{4} \overline{p^{2}}}{4 \pi c^{3}} \int_{0}^{2 \pi} \mathrm{d}\varphi \int_{0}^{\pi} \sin^{3} \theta \mathrm{d}\theta = \frac{2 \omega^{4}}{3 c^{3} p^{2}}\tag{7}
$$

利用(4)式，同时电偶极矩 $\vec { p } = - q \vec { \xi }$

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}W}{\mathrm{d}t}=\frac{2\omega^{4}}{3c^{3}}\frac{\overline{p^{2}}}{p^{2}}=\frac{2\omega^{4}}{3c^{3}}\cdot\frac{1}{\omega^{4}}\left(-q\vec{\xi}\right)^{2}=\frac{2q^{2}}{3c^{3}}\left(\vec{\xi}\right)^{2}\tag{8}
$$

拉莫尔公式中常数:

$$
k   =   \frac { 2 } { 3 }\tag{9}
$$

(3)类比(2)可知，辐射功率为:

$$

(14)

$$
T \equiv - \left( \frac{\Omega}{\dot{\Omega}} \right)_0 = \frac{6Ic^3}{B_p^2R^6 \sin^2 \alpha \Omega^2}\tag{15}

questions.title: 第 05 题
tags: 热学/统计物理/玻尔兹曼分布/磁化强度
热学/热力学第二定律/卡诺循环/制冷机与热泵性能
questions.content:
解析:(1)外界磁场后，顺磁体空间取向满足玻尔兹曼分布律:

$$
\boldsymbol{E} = - \boldsymbol{m}_{0} \cdot \boldsymbol{B} = - m_{0} B \cos \theta\tag{1}
$$

式中k为玻尔兹曼常量，E为H与 $m _ { 0 }$ 的相互作用能，故

$$
\mathrm{d}n = C\exp\left(\frac{m_0B\cos\theta}{kT}\right)\mathrm{d}\Omega\tag{2}
$$

为了确定常数C，对上式应在4π立体角内积分后有:

$$
\frac{n}{\int \exp \left( \frac{m_{0} B \cos \theta}{kT} \right) \mathrm{d} \Omega} = \frac{n}{2 \pi \int_{0}^{\pi} \exp \left( \frac{m_{0} B \cos \theta}{kT} \right) \sin \theta \mathrm{d} \theta}\tag{3}
$$

各分子的固有磁矩 $m_0$ 的空间取向对于z轴(磁场B的方向)是对称的，B的平面内的分量彼此抵消，只剩下z分量.磁化强度:

$$
\begin{aligned}M = \int m_{0} \cos \theta \mathrm{d}n = 2 \pi C m_{0} \int_{0}^{\pi} \cos \theta \exp \left( \frac{m_{0} B \cos \theta}{kT} \right) \sin \theta \mathrm{d}\theta \\= \frac{n m_{0}}{\int_{0}^{\pi} \exp \left( \frac{m_{0} B \cos \theta}{kT} \right) \sin \theta \mathrm{d}\theta} \int_{0}^{\pi} \exp \left( \frac{m_{0} B \cos \theta}{kT} \right) \sin \theta \cos \theta \mathrm{d}\theta.\end{aligned}\tag{4}
$$

令 t = cos θ, $a = \frac { m _ { 0 } B } { k T }$ ，则

$$
M = n m _ { 0 } \frac { \int _ { - 1 } ^ { 1 } t \mathrm { e } ^ { a t } \mathrm { d } t } { \int _ { - 1 } ^ { 1 } \mathrm { e } ^ { a t } \mathrm { d } t } = N m _ { 0 } \left( \frac { \mathrm { e } ^ { a } + \mathrm { e } ^ { - a } } { \mathrm { e } ^ { a } - \mathrm { e } ^ { - a } } - \frac { 1 } { a } \right)\tag{5}
$$

对于室温 $a \ll 1$，泰勒展开，保留高阶小量

$$
\frac{e^{a}+e^{-a}}{e^{a}-e^{-a}}-\frac{1}{a}=\frac{\left(1+a+\frac{a^{2}}{2}+\cdots\right)+\left(1-a+\frac{a^{2}}{2}-\cdots\right)}{\left(1+a+\frac{a^{2}}{2}+\frac{a^{3}}{6}+\cdots\right)-\left(1-a+\frac{a^{2}}{2}-\frac{a^{3}}{6}+\cdots\right)}-\frac{1}{a}\\=\frac{2+a^{2}}{2a+\frac{a^{3}}{3}}-\frac{1}{a}=\frac{1}{a}\left(\frac{6+3a^{2}}{6+a^{2}}-1\right)=\frac{2a}{6+a^{2}}\approx\frac{a}{3}\tag{6}
$$

$$
M = \frac{Nm_{0}^{2}}{3kT}B, \quad \chi = \frac{\frac{Nm_{0}^{2}}{3kT}}{\frac{1}{\mu_{0}} - \frac{Nm_{0}^{3}}{3kT}} \approx \frac{\mu_{0}Nm_{0}^{2}}{3kT}, \quad C = \frac{\mu_{0}Nm_{0}^{2}}{3k}\tag{7}
$$

(2)根据提示，磁介质的热力学基本方程可表达为

$$
\begin{aligned} &T\mathrm{d}S = \mathrm{d}U - \mu_{0}H\mathrm{d}M = C_{M}\mathrm{d}T - \mu_{0}H\mathrm{d}\left(\frac{CH}{T}\right)\\ &= \left(C_{M} + \frac{C\mu_{0}H^{2}}{T^{2}}\right)\mathrm{d}T - \frac{C\mu_{0}H}{T}\mathrm{d}H\\ \end{aligned}\tag{8}
$$

其中 $C = \frac { N m _ { 0 } } { 3 k }$ ，对比可知，由此得

$$
T \left( \frac{\partial S}{\partial H} \right)_T = - \frac{C \mu_0 H}{T}\tag{9}
$$

在①等温过程中， $T _ { \mathrm { t } }$ 保持不变,磁场从 $H _ { a }$ 变到 $H _ { b }$ ,其熵变

$$
\Delta S_{1}=-\frac{C\mu_{0}}{T_{1}^{2}}\int_{H_{a}}^{H_{b}}H\mathrm{d}H=\frac{C\mu_{0}}{2T_{1}^{2}}\left(H_{a}^{2}-H_{b}^{2}\right)\tag{10}
$$

此过程中放热为:

$$
\Delta Q_{1}=T_{1}\Delta S_{1}=\frac{\mu_{0}}{2T_{1}}\frac{Nm_{0}}{3k}\left(H_{a}^{2}-H_{b}^{2}\right)\tag{11}
$$

同理在③等温过程中，此过程中吸热为:

$$
\Delta Q_{2}=\frac{\mu_{0}}{2T_{2}}\frac{Nm_{0}}{3k}\left(H_{c}^{2}-H_{d}^{2}\right)=\frac{\mu_{0}}{2T_{2}}\frac{Nm_{0}}{3k}H_{c}^{2}\tag{12}
$$

又由于在①③等温熵的变化量满足:

$$
\Delta S _ { 2 } = - \Delta S _ { 1 }\tag{13}
$$

$$
\Delta Q_{2}=T_{2}\Delta S_{2}=-T_{2}\Delta S_{1}=T_{2}\frac{\mu_{0}}{2T_{1}^{2}}\frac{Nm_{0}}{3k}\left(H_{a}^{2}-H_{b}^{2}\right)\tag{14}
$$

$$
H_{c}=\frac{T_{2}}{T_{1}}\sqrt{H_{a}^{2}-H_{b}^{2}}\tag{15}
$$

制冷系数有:

$$
e = \frac{\left| \Delta Q_{2} \right|}{\left| \Delta Q_{1} \right| - \left| \Delta Q_{2} \right|} = \frac{T_{2}}{T_{1} - T_{2}}\tag{16}
$$

评分标准:

第(1)问:20分；(1)(2)(3)2分，(4)3分，(5)(6)4分，(7)3分；

第(2)问:20分；(8)3分，(9)-(15)2分，(16)3分；

questions.content:
解析(1)边缘光线如图所示:

![](data/images/2023-ee12bca3/2023-量子-答案_part01-3.jpg)

$$\frac{a^{2}-c^{2}}{a}=\frac{a^{2}-c^{2}}{1-\frac{c}{a}\cos60^{\circ}}=\frac{a^{2}-c^{2}}{a-c\cos60^{\circ}}\tag{1}$$

$$\frac{a^{2}-c^{2}}{a}=\frac{a^{2}-c^{2}}{1-\frac{c}{a}\cos60^{\circ}}=\frac{a^{2}-c^{2}}{a+c\cos30^{\circ}}\tag{2}$$

可变光阑中心设为D，由几何关系:

$$\frac{r_{1}}{\overline{F_{1}A}\sin60^{\circ}}=\frac{\overline{F_{2}D}}{2c-\overline{F_{1}A}\cos60^{\circ}}\tag{3}$$

$$\frac{r_{2}}{\overline{F_{1}B}\sin30^{\circ}}=\frac{\overline{F_{2}D}}{2c+\overline{F_{1}B}\cos30^{\circ}}\tag{4}$$

$$\frac{r_{1}}{r_{2}}=\frac{2c+\overline{F_{1}B}\cos30^{\circ}\overline{F_{1}A}\sin60^{\circ}}{2c-\overline{F_{1}A}\cos60^{\circ}\overline{F_{1}B}\sin30^{\circ}}\tag{5}$$

代入(1)(2)式有:

$$\frac{r_{1}}{r_{2}}=\frac{4\sqrt{3}e+3e^{2}+3}{4e-e^{2}-1}\tag{6}$$

(2)如图所示，出射角为θ时:

![](data/images/2023-ee12bca3/2023-量子-答案_part01-4.jpg)

由几何关系:

$$\frac{a^{2}-c^{2}}{a}=\frac{a^{2}-c^{2}}{1-c\cos\theta}=\frac{a^{2}-c^{2}}{a-c\cos\theta}\tag{7}$$

$$\overrightarrow{F_{2}E}=2a-\overrightarrow{F_{1}E}=2a-\frac{a^{2}-c^{2}}{a-c\cos\theta}=\frac{a^{2}+c^{2}-2ac\cos\theta}{a-c\cos\theta}\tag{8}$$

考虑正弦定理:

$$\frac{\overline{F_{1}E}}{\sin\varphi}=\frac{\overline{F_{2}E}}{\sin\theta}\tag{9}$$

则出射到光屏时的高度有:

$$r = f \tan \varphi\tag{10}$$

代入上式有:

$$r = \frac{3\sin \theta}{4 - 5\cos \theta}f\tag{11}$$

由于灯泡各方向放光亮度一样，设光源出单位角度内发光强度 $I_{0}$ ，则在不考虑球面镜反射时:

$$\left| \sin \theta \mathrm{d} \theta I_{0} \right| = \left| r \mathrm{d} r I(r) \right|\tag{12}$$

将(10)平方两边微分有:

$$2r\mathrm{d}r = 9f^{2}\frac{4\cos\theta - 5}{\left( 4 - 5\cos\theta \right)^{3}}2\sin\theta\mathrm{d}\theta\tag{13}$$

取绝对值有:

$$I(r) = I_{0} \frac{(4 - 5 \cos \theta)^{3}}{9 f^{2}(5 - 4 \cos \theta)}\tag{14}$$

考虑到球面镜光源反射:

$$I(r)=\left\{\begin{aligned}&I_{0}\frac{(4-5\cos\theta)^{3}}{9f^{2}(5-4\cos\theta)}\times2\quad(120^{\circ}<\theta<150^{\circ})\\&I_{0}\frac{(4-5\cos\theta)^{3}}{9f^{2}(5-4\cos\theta)}\quad(60^{\circ}<\theta<120^{\circ})\end{aligned}\right.\tag{15}$$

$$I(r)=\left\{\begin{aligned}&I_{0}\frac{9f(4f+5\sqrt{r^{2}+f^{2}})^{2}}{(25r^{2}+9f^{2})^{2}\sqrt{r^{2}+f^{2}}}\times2\quad(\frac{-24+15\sqrt{3}}{11}f<r<\frac{3}{13}\sqrt{3}f)\\&I_{0}\frac{9f(4f+5\sqrt{r^{2}+f^{2}})^{2}}{(25r^{2}+9f^{2})^{2}\sqrt{r^{2}+f^{2}}}\quad(\frac{3}{13}\sqrt{3}f<r<\sqrt{3}f)\end{aligned}\right.$$

$$\begin{aligned}I(r) = \left\{ \begin{aligned} \frac{9I_{0}}{f^{2}}\frac{2(4 + 5\sqrt{x^{2} + 1})^{2}}{(9 + 25x^{2})^{2}\sqrt{x^{2} + 1}} & \quad (x = \frac{r}{f}, \frac{- 24 + 15\sqrt{3}}{11} < x < \frac{3}{13}\sqrt{3}) \\ \frac{9I_{0}}{f^{2}}\frac{(4 + 5\sqrt{x^{2} + 1})^{2}}{(9 + 25x^{2})^{2}\sqrt{x^{2} + 1}} & \quad (x = \frac{r}{f}, \frac{3}{13}\sqrt{3} < x < \sqrt{3}) \end{aligned} \right.\end{aligned}\tag{16}$$

由(16)(17)可知， $x = \frac{- 24 + 15\sqrt{3}}{11}$ ，为极大值

$$I_{m}=15.2\frac{I_{0}}{f^{2}}\tag{17}$$

$$\frac{1.18I_{m}(4 + 5\sqrt{x^{2} + 1})^{2}}{(9 + 25x^{2})^{2}\sqrt{x^{2} + 1}} \quad (x = \frac{r}{f}, \frac{- 24 + 15\sqrt{3}}{11} < x < \frac{3}{13}\sqrt{3})\tag{18}$$

第(1)问:20分；(1)-(4)2分，(5)4分，(6)8分；

第(2)问:40分；(7-9)(12)(13)2分，(10)(11)(14-17)4分，(18)6分；

questions.analysis:
解析:(1)系统的质心速度为:

$$v_{c}=\frac{Mv}{M+m}\tag{1}$$

在质心系中，散射前后m的速度为:

$$v_{m}^{\prime}=\frac{Mv}{M+m}\tag{2}$$

如图所示，质心系中，在质心系中散射角为α角时，实验室系下:

$$\theta = \frac { \alpha } { 2 }\tag{3}$$

在质心系中出射各向同性:

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}P}{\mathrm{d}\alpha} = \frac{2\pi\sin\alpha}{4\pi}\tag{4}$$

故在实验室中:

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}P}{\mathrm{d}\theta} = \frac{\mathrm{d}P}{\mathrm{d}\alpha} \frac{\mathrm{d}\alpha}{\mathrm{d}\theta} = \frac{\sin 2\theta}{2} 2 = \sin 2\theta\tag{5}$$

由 $0 \leq \alpha \leq \pi$ ，故碰后m出射方向的空间角分布 $\frac { \mathrm { d } P } { \mathrm { d } \theta }$

$$f(\theta) = \frac{\mathrm{d}P}{\mathrm{d}\theta} = \sin 2\theta \qquad (0 \leq \alpha \leq \frac{\pi}{2})\tag{6}$$

对于最概然方向满足:

$$\frac{2(\frac{\mathrm{d}P}{\mathrm{d}\theta})}{\mathrm{d}\theta}=2\cos2\theta=0\tag{7}$$

$$\theta   =   \frac { \pi } { 4 }\tag{8}$$

![](data/images/2023-ee12bca3/2023-量子-答案_part01-5.jpg)

![](data/images/2023-ee12bca3/2023-量子-答案_part01-6.jpg)

(2)相对论条件下，类似(1)给出0动量系速度:

$$v_{c}=\frac{\frac{M}{\sqrt{1-\beta^{2}}}v}{\frac{M}{\sqrt{1-\beta^{2}}}+m}=\frac{Mv}{M+m\sqrt{1-\beta^{2}}}\tag{9}$$

对于零动量系中的弹性碰撞，碰撞前后有:

$$\begin{aligned} &p_{m}^{\prime}=m^{\prime}v_{c}=\frac{mv_{c}}{\sqrt{1-\left(\frac{v_{c}}{c}\right)^{2}}}=\frac{mv_{c}}{\sqrt{1-\left(\beta_{c}\right)^{2}}}=\gamma_{c}mv_{c}\\ &E_{m}^{\prime}=m^{\prime}c^{2}\\ \end{aligned}\tag{10}$$

考虑相对论能动量变换:

$$\left\{ \begin{aligned} p _ { m x } & = \gamma _ { C } \left( p _ { m x } ^ { \prime } + \frac { v _ { C } E _ { m } ^ { \prime } } { c ^ { 2 } } \right) = \gamma _ { C } \left( p _ { m } ^ { \prime } \cos \theta ^ { \prime } + \frac { \beta _ { C } E _ { m } ^ { \prime } } { c } \right) \\ p _ { m y } & = p _ { m y } ^ { \prime } = p _ { m } ^ { \prime } \sin \theta ^ { \prime } \end{aligned} \right.$$

则有:

(11)

$$\cot \theta = \frac{p_{mx}}{p_{my}} = \gamma_{c} \left( \cot \theta' + \frac{\beta_{c} E'_{m}}{p'_{m} c} \csc \theta' \right) = \gamma_{c} \cot \frac{\theta'}{2}\tag{12}$$

同样在质心系中出射各向同性:

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}P}{\mathrm{d}\theta^{\prime}}=\frac{2\pi\sin\theta^{\prime}}{4\pi}=\frac{\sin\theta^{\prime}}{2}\tag{13}$$

故在实验室中:

$$f(\theta) = \frac{\mathrm{d}P}{\mathrm{d}\theta} = \frac{\mathrm{d}P}{\mathrm{d}\theta} \frac{\mathrm{d}\theta'}{\mathrm{d}\theta} = \frac{\sin^2 \frac{\theta'}{2} \cdot \sin \theta'}{\gamma_c \sin^2 \theta} = \frac{2\gamma_c^2 \tan \theta}{(1 + \gamma_c^2 \tan^2 \theta)^2 \cos^2 \theta} = \frac{2\gamma_c^2 \cot \theta}{(\gamma_c^2 + \cot^2 \theta)^2 \sin^2 \theta}\tag{14}$$

同样有 $0 \leq \theta \leq \frac { \pi } { 2 }$ ，其中:

$$\gamma_{c}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-\frac{\nu_{e}^{2}}{c^{2}}}}=\frac{(M+m\sqrt{1-\beta^{2}})}{\sqrt{(M^{2}+m^{2})(1-\beta^{2})+2Mm\sqrt{1-\beta^{2}}}} \quad (\beta=\frac{\nu_{e}}{c})$$

对于最概然方向:

$$\frac { \mathrm { d } ( \frac { \mathrm { d } P } { \mathrm { d } \theta } ) } { \mathrm { d } \theta } = 0\tag{15}$$

$$\theta = \frac{1}{2} \arccos \frac{1 + \gamma_c^2 - \sqrt{(1 + \gamma_c^2)^2 + 8(1 - \gamma_c^2)^2}}{2(1 - \gamma_c^2)}$$

给出M=2m，ν=0.6c时的结果:

$$\theta = 0 . 6 8 5 6 r a d\tag{16}$$

(3)考虑能动量变换:

(17)

$$E = \gamma_{c} \left( E' + \nu_{c} p_{m}' \cos \theta' \right) = \gamma_{c} \left( \gamma_{c} m c^{2} + \nu_{c} \gamma_{c} m \nu_{c} \frac{\cot^{2} \theta - \gamma_{c}^{2}}{\cot^{2} \theta + \gamma_{c}^{2}} \right)\tag{18}$$

$$f(\theta) \mathrm{d}\theta = f(E) \mathrm{d}E\tag{19}$$

$$f(E)=\frac{1}{2\gamma_{c}^{2}m\gamma_{c}^{2}}\tag{20}$$

故可以得到能量概率为均匀分布，

$$mc^{2} \leq E \leq mc^{2}(2\gamma_{c}^{2}-1)\tag{21}$$

第(1)问:15分；(2-4)(7)(8)2分，(5)1分，(6)4分；

第(2)问:35分；(10)(13)2分，(9)(11)(12)(15)4分,(14)(16)6分，(17)3分；

第(3)问:10分；(18)(19)2分，(20)(21)3分。
